assessment_contract.not_matched: Requires a source-bound State, assessment date, EU territory, a complete applicable Part 2, and currentness evidence covering the assessment date. It is permitted only where that complete Part 2 has no entry for the State.
assessment_contract.matched: Requires a separate official national or institutional source binding the concrete scheme and benefit to an applicable Part 2 entry.
assessment_contract.fail_closed: Incomplete, conflicting, stale, unsupported-territory, or unresolved source evidence is not_assessed with data_gaps.
assessment_contract.interval_semantics: All ledger and evidence validity intervals are half-open [valid_from, valid_to).

limitations: No concrete national scheme or benefit mapping is recorded by this contract.
No source in this contract establishes currentness after 2019-07-31.
This contract does not infer payer, entitlement, competent institution, amount, effective date, or payment.
